name: Tokubetsu Jugyou
source:
Main character becomes a temporary art instructor to a famous all girls school with strict discipline. He pretends to take his job seriously, but in fact he only lusts for flesh of the cutest girls. With the help of Saki, another instructor, he plans to make all of his targets at this famous all girls school his pets.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
